settings.heading: Security Settings
settings.subhead: Lock, unlock, and protect your wallet

activity_log.label: Activity log
activity_log.description: Off by default · stored on this device only
activity_log.help: Private log: what you changed, sent, revoked. No amounts or addresses. Panic Wipe erases it.

message_signing.label: Message signing
message_signing.description: Off by default · stored on this device only
message_signing.help: Off by default. Lets you sign arbitrary text messages with your wallet key. Only enable if a dApp or service asks you to sign a message.

telemetry.label: Anonymous usage data
telemetry.description: Opt-in · never includes balances or addresses
telemetry.help: Helps us find bugs and improve the app. A random device ID is used — never linked to your wallet, keys, or identity. Turning this off stops all usage data leaving this device.

delete_account.title: Danger Zone
delete_account.clear_cache_description: Clears saved data on this device and locks the wallet. Your recovery phrase still works. To erase keys, use Panic Wipe.
delete_account.confirm_prompt_pre: This clears saved data and locks the wallet. Your recovery phrase still works. Type
delete_account.confirm_aria: Type DELETE to confirm account reset

biometric_unlock.heading: Biometric Unlock
biometric_unlock.kdf_disclosure: One-tap unlock saves your wallet password on this device, protected by your screen lock and biometrics. If someone gets a copy of your device backup without the physical device, they could access your wallet. Turn this off for the strongest protection.
biometric_unlock.app_layer_disclosure_pre: Biometric unlock saves your password on this device, protected by your fingerprint or face. This runs inside the app, not at the operating system level.
biometric_unlock.toggle_description: Enable one-tap unlock for your primary wallet using device biometrics.
biometric_unlock.confirm_disclosure: If someone gets a copy of your device backup without the physical device, they could access your wallet. Only turn this on if you're OK with that.
biometric_unlock.status_check_failed: Could not check biometric availability on this device.

passkey_unlock.scope_banner_native_pre: Your fingerprint or face is checked before unlocking —
passkey_unlock.scope_banner_native_post: not a replacement for your password. Your password and recovery phrase still work on their own, so losing biometrics never locks you out.
passkey_unlock.scope_banner_web_pre: A passkey adds a quick biometric or security-key tap before unlocking —
passkey_unlock.scope_banner_web_post: not a replacement for your password. Your password and recovery phrase still work on their own, so losing the passkey never locks you out.
passkey_unlock.not_setup_native: Device biometrics are not set up. Add a fingerprint or face in your device settings first — your password still works.
passkey_unlock.not_supported_web: Passkey unlock isn't available in this browser. It works in the mobile app and modern browsers. Use your password here.
passkey_unlock.enroll_error: Could not enroll biometric unlock on this device.
passkey_unlock.register_error: Could not register a passkey on this device.
passkey_unlock.require_toggle_desc_native: Ask for your device biometric before unlocking (your password still works).
passkey_unlock.require_toggle_desc_web: Ask for your passkey before unlocking (your password still works).
passkey_unlock.applies_all_sessions: This applies to all wallet sessions on this device.

hardware_kek.heading: On-device hardware protection
hardware_kek.description_pre: Locks your wallet to this physical device. After enabling, your wallet can only be opened on
hardware_kek.description_post: . A stolen backup file is useless without the device itself, even with your PIN.
hardware_kek.description_web_suffix: Works on Chrome 99+ and Firefox 108+. Safari is not supported.
hardware_kek.device_binding_note: Device binding is active and tested on real hardware.
hardware_kek.web_prf_unsupported: Hardware protection isn't available on this browser. Use Chrome 99+ or Firefox 108+, or use the iOS or Android app.

errors.wrong_pin: Wrong PIN — enter the PIN you use to unlock your wallet.
errors.no_hardware: Couldn't reach this device's hardware security. Try again, or use a different device.
errors.malformed_vault: Your stored wallet data couldn't be read on this device.
errors.not_enrolled: Hardware protection isn't enabled on this vault, so there's nothing to upgrade.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.key_invalidated: Your fingerprints changed — hardware protection was invalidated. Disable and re-enable hardware protection, or restore from your seed phrase.
errors.insecure_tier: This device has no secure hardware element — hardware protection can't be enabled here.
errors.enter_pin_confirm_removal: Enter your vault PIN to confirm removal.
errors.enter_pin_upgrade: Enter your vault PIN to upgrade.

toast.enabled: Hardware protection enabled — your vault now requires this device to unlock.
toast.upgraded: Hardware protection upgraded — your vault is now bound with a unique per-device key.

pin_strength.hardware_body: Your PIN combined with Face ID, fingerprint, or passkey makes offline attacks infeasible — an attacker would need both your PIN and this physical device.
pin_strength.no_hardware_title: No hardware factor available in this browser.
pin_strength.no_hardware_body: Your 8-digit PIN (~100 M combinations) is protected only by Argon2id — a dedicated attacker could exhaust it offline in days to weeks. Use a password of 12+ characters, or switch to Chrome/Firefox to enable hardware protection.
pin_strength.pre_enroll_body: An 8-digit PIN has ~100 M combinations. Argon2id slows offline attacks to roughly 1–2 years single-threaded — but a GPU cluster could cut that to days. Enabling Face ID, fingerprint, or passkey above makes offline attacks infeasible by requiring this device for every unlock.

enrolled.active_body_native: Your vault requires this device's biometric to unlock.
enrolled.active_body_web: Your vault requires this device's passkey to unlock.

upgrade.available_body: Your wallet was protected with an older version that shared a key across devices. Upgrade to lock it to this device only. This happens once and asks you to verify twice.
upgrade.prompt: Enter your vault PIN. You'll authenticate twice to re-secure the vault.

remove.prompt_native: Enter your PIN to confirm. You'll need to verify with your fingerprint or face.
remove.prompt_web: Enter your password to confirm. You'll need to verify with your passkey.

enroll.prompt_native: Enter your vault PIN to enable hardware protection.
enroll.prompt_web: Enter your 8-digit PIN to enable hardware protection. Your browser will create a passkey to lock your wallet to this device.
enroll.footnote_native: You will be asked to authenticate with your device biometric or passcode.
enroll.footnote_web: Your browser will ask you to authenticate with a biometric or device PIN to create the passkey.

hardware_kek.blocked: Hardware protection settings are not available in this session.

two_factor.heading: Two-factor at critical actions
two_factor.intro: An extra check on top of your PIN for sensitive actions. Even if someone sees you type your PIN, they still can't do these things without the second step.
two_factor.setup_blocked: You're in a decoy / hidden session. Configure two-factor from your real session.
two_factor.method_a_desc: A second password saved inside your wallet. Strong, but both passwords live on the same device.
two_factor.action_password_hint: At least 8 characters · any characters allowed
two_factor.toast_set_error: Could not set the Action Password
two_factor.toast_confirm_pin_required: Enter your wallet PIN / password to confirm
two_factor.toast_remove_error: Could not remove the Action Password
two_factor.method_b_desc_native: Your PIN plus {{label}}. If biometrics aren't available, the action is blocked. Losing your device never loses your funds.
two_factor.method_b_desc_web: Your PIN plus a passkey tap. If the passkey isn't available, the action is blocked. Losing it never loses your funds.
two_factor.switch_aria_native: Use my device biometrics as my second factor
two_factor.switch_aria_web: Use passkey as my second factor
two_factor.unavailable_native: {{label}} / device passcode is not set up on this device — enable it in your device settings to use this factor.
two_factor.unsupported_web: This browser doesn't support WebAuthn / passkeys.
two_factor.register_hint_web_pre: No passkey registered yet — set one up in
two_factor.toggle_biometric_needed: {{label}} is not set up on this device.
two_factor.toggle_passkey_needed: Register a passkey first (Wallet Passkeys, below).

session.title: Session & Auto-lock
session.description: Locks your wallet after a period of inactivity or when you leave the app
session.never_note: No auto-lock on idle, but it still locks after ~45 s in the background and after 8 hours unlocked.
session.resets_note: Resets whenever you interact with the app. Also locks immediately when backgrounded.

rehearsal.title: Rehearse deniability
rehearsal.description: See the dashboard exactly as someone holding your unlocked phone would.

recipient.label: Send to (address or name)
recipient.placeholder: Paste an address or enter a name (e.g. vitalik.eth)
recipient.name_not_found: Name not found — check the spelling or paste the address directly.
recipient.ens_confirm_intro: looked up privately on the blockchain to:
recipient.ens_confirm_hint: Confirm this address is correct before sending.
recipient.not_whitelisted: This address is not on your whitelist. Double-check before proceeding. You can add trusted addresses in Settings.
recipient.self_send_warning: You're sending to your own wallet address. This moves nothing between wallets and still costs a network fee. Double-check the recipient before continuing.

screening.local_disclosure: Recipients are checked on your device for scam addresses against your own history — nothing leaves your device.
screening.remote_opt_in: Also screen against an online threat database (sends this transaction's details to a third party)
screening.remote_unavailable: Online screening is enabled, but no provider is configured in this build — screening stays local, so we couldn't verify this against an external list.
screening.remote_enabled: Online threat intelligence screening is active. At the verify step this sends the recipient address, your own sending address, the amount, and — for token transfers — the contract address and call data to the TIP service. Nothing from your transaction history is sent.

simulation.title: Transaction Simulation
simulation.description: Before you sign, we run a local pre-flight check — no third-party services, no data leaves your device.
simulation.results_hint: Results appear at the next step once you enter an address and amount.
simulation.off_hint: Simulation is off — no pre-flight check will run before signing.
